title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Minnesota over law to ban 'nudify' apps
summary_full: Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX, is challenging a law that would ban so-called nudify apps in Minnesota
summary_public: Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX, is challenging a law that would ban so-called nudify apps in Minnesota
